note: Load form (research/load-harness.md) for L04's sql twins: bytes on the wire per response, k6 offering gzip and br as a browser does. The planted list sends every column of each product, uncompressed (DAT-04, DAT-08); the planted product page is uncompressed (DAT-08). A twin reports at twice the other's bytes and at least 2 kB. The count and the health check are small in both twins: the decoys. The list page's call per product (DAT-01) is counted per page view by the trace form; under load it would only multiply the requests. Each step runs at a fixed arrival rate (k6), each twin judged against the other over 3 repeats, every finding under the timing rule. defects are what the planted twin must report and the clean twin must not; every other judged step is a decoy, in both twins.
